entry.author: nzpost
entry.summary:
Learn how to set up the address validation feature on eShip to correct errors in your customers’ addresses. 
  
Login to My NZ Post Business to visit your eShip portal to access these features: https://eship.nzpost.co.nz/
Resources for cleansing addresses: 
https://www.nzpost.co.nz/business/shipping-in-nz/bulk-mail/address-certification/cleaning-addresses 
  
NZ Post’s addressing standards: 
https://www.nzpost.co.nz/business/shipping-in-nz/addressing-standards.
  
0:08 - Bulk auto-correct addresses 
0:26 - Auto-correct individual addresses 
0:55 - Manually edit an address
